question: Find all values of $k \in \mathbb{R}$ for which $f: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ defined as $f(x)=kx$ is bijective.
explanation: $f$ is bijective if and only if $k \neq 0$, because $f$ is then both one-one (injective) and onto (surjective) as it becomes a linear bijection.
